lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: How should a citizen handle a grievance or dispute regarding an officer's conduct during a traffic stop?

options.text: Comply during the stop, then file a formal complaint with internal affairs later
Physically resist the officer or attempt to drive away from the traffic stop
Refuse to show driver license and challenge the officer on roadside pavement
Shout obscenities through the closed window and refuse all communication
